title: Netflix Celebrates 15 Years in Brazil With the Stars Who Shaped Our History
summary: Netflix brought together hundreds of stars from its past, present and future in São Paulo to celebrate its 15 years in Brazil
body_markdown:
It's the ultimate office party! Netflix brought together hundreds of stars from its past, present and future in São Paulo to celebrate 15 years in Brazil, developing local stories that have won over audiences at home and around the world.


The


[red carpet](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br/destaques/netflix-15-anos-no-brasil-festa-looks-convidados) featured pure main character energy, with household names such as Alice Wegmann, André Lamoglia, Bella Campos, Camila Pitanga, Emicida, Johnny Massaro, Juliana Paes, Lorena Comparato, Maeve Jinkings, Marco Pigossi, Paolla Oliveira, Reynaldo Gianecchini and Seu Jorge, among other familiar faces who are part of Netflix's journey in Brazil.


The night's music was curated by Zé Ricardo of Rock World, who created brand-new, 100% Brazilian jam sessions for the guests. Hosted by Glória Groove and Xamã, the event also featured performances by Duquesa and MC Cabelinho. DJ sets came from Clube Vittar (Pabllo Vittar) and the duo Kenan e Kel.


To keep the celebration going, Netflix prepared a surprise for fans in Brazil: a


[series of short sketches](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br/destaques/netflix-15-anos-no-brasil-festa-esquetes) starring some of the actors who attended the party, playing typical office party characters in familiar situations, from being turned away at the door to the rivalries that surface by the end of the night.
